headline: ACME Solar commissions 50.01 MW solar capacity
summary: ACME Solar Holdings commissioned an additional 50.01 MW of solar capacity at its Bikaner Hybrid Power Project on November 26, 2026, bringing cumulative solar output to 250.05 MW.

headline: Trom Industries wins Rs 10.11 Cr solar order from AMC
summary: Trom Industries secured a Rs 10.11 Cr work order from Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation for 2.5 MWp solar systems. This significant inflow contrasts with Q1FY27's Rs 1.71 Cr, signaling potential revenue acceleration despite low current TTM revenue visibility.

headline: Global Pet Industries wins Rs 3.2 crore order from Omniflux
summary: Global Pet Industries secured a Rs 3.2 crore work order for PET manufacturing lines. This follows a Rs 15.04 crore inflow in Q3FY27. Book-to-bill context remains critical given recent revenue trends.

headline: Abs Marine wins Rs 120.14 Cr order from ONGC
summary: Abs Marine Services secures a Rs 120.14 crore charter hire order from ONGC for PSV Emerald. This adds to recent inflows, with total disclosed backlog at Rs 311.16 Cr against FY26 revenue of Rs 322.60 Cr.

headline: Urban Enviro wins Rs 2.22 Cr waste order from Nagar Panchayat Aheri
summary: Urban Enviro Waste Management secured a Rs 2.22 crore work order for waste processing in Maharashtra. This adds to its recent inflows, with Q1FY27 seeing Rs 39.82 crore in orders.

headline: Adisoft wins Rs 12.56 Cr order for Industry 4.0 solutions
summary: Adisoft Technologies secured a Rs 12.56 crore commercial order from a domestic private entity. The deal covers automated assembly and robotic cells, extending backlog visibility through March 2027.

headline: Rachana Infra wins Rs 147 Cr road order from Ahmedabad R&B
summary: Rachana Infrastructure secured a Rs 146.98 crore work order for road widening in Gujarat. The deal, awarded by Ahmedabad (R&B) Division, adds to a Rs 295.71 crore Q3 inflow, significantly boosting the company's backlog relative to its recent revenue base.

headline: Swaraj Suiting gets in-principle approval for preferential issue
summary: Swaraj Suiting Ltd received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for a preferential issue of 35 lakh equity shares and 17 lakh warrants at ₹335 each.

headline: Omnitech Engineering wins development order from BrahMos
summary: Omnitech Engineering has received a development order from BrahMos Aerospace for assemblies and sub-assemblies of metallic airframe components and canister subsystems.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Texmaco, Ashiana, EMS in focus
summary: Texmaco rallies 4.86% on new wagon orders, while Ashiana Housing gains 3.18% after a ₹1,100 crore land acquisition. EMS and Walchandnagar also draw attention with fresh contracts.

headline: Biocon secures Brazil approval for Pertuzumab biosimilar
summary: Biocon announced ANVISA approval for Hertuzo, a biosimilar Pertuzumab, in Brazil. The move supports a 10-year partnership with Bionovis to supply HER2-positive breast cancer treatment.
